A2-1-0.name: Three-part statement
A2-1-0.prompt: Para cada pista, di una afirmación, una negación y una pregunta en pasado simple.
answers: I sent the report. / I didn’t send the report. / Did you send the report?
I saw the message. / I didn’t see the message. / Did you see the message?
I was at the office. / I wasn’t at the office. / Were you at the office?
I had time to check it. / I didn’t have time to check it. / Did you have time to check it?
I went to the second session. / I didn’t go to the second session. / Did you go to the second session?

A2-1-1.name: Then and not now
A2-1-1.prompt: Di una oración con «used to» y enseguida di cómo es la realidad hoy.
answers: I used to take the bus to work. Now I ride my bike.
I used to eat a lot of fast food. Now I cook at home.
I used to play video games every night. Now I go running.
I used to have an old phone with no internet. Now I have a smartphone.
I used to live in Pereira. Now I live in Bogotá.

A2-2-0.name: Sort and ask
A2-2-0.prompt: Para cada sustantivo, di si es contable o no contable, y luego haz la pregunta con «how much / how many».
answers: Noncount. — How much information do you need?
Count. — How many chairs are there in the room?
Noncount. — How much furniture is there in the flat?
Count. — How many emails did you get today?
Noncount. — How much homework do you have tonight?

A2-2-1.name: Wrap the question
A2-2-1.prompt: Convierte cada pregunta directa en indirecta usando una introducción distinta cada vez.
items: How much is a single ticket?
answers: Could you tell me where platform 4 is?
Do you know what time it closes?
I’d like to know how much a single ticket is.
I was wondering if I can pay by card.
Do you have any idea if the wifi is free?

A2-3-0.name: Three verdicts
A2-3-0.prompt: Evalúa cada cosa de tres formas: con «too», con «not … enough» y con «as … as».
answers: The flat was too small. / It wasn’t bright enough. / It wasn’t as nice as my old flat.
My phone is too slow. / The battery isn’t good enough. / It isn’t as fast as my brother’s phone.
The timetable is too long. / The breaks aren’t long enough. / It isn’t as flexible as last year’s timetable.
The buses are too crowded. / There aren’t enough metro lines. / It isn’t as efficient as I would like.
My speaking is too slow. / My vocabulary isn’t big enough. / My writing isn’t as good as my reading.

A2-3-1.name: One step back
A2-3-1.prompt: Convierte cada afirmación verdadera en un deseo moviendo el verbo un paso atrás en el tiempo.
answers: I wish I had a car.
I wish I could play the piano.
I wish I lived closer to work.
I wish I hadn’t said something stupid.
I wish it weren’t raining.

A2-4-0.name: Open then close
A2-4-0.prompt: Pregunta con el presente perfecto y responde con el pasado simple y un tiempo terminado.
answers: Have you ever changed jobs? — Yes, I changed jobs in 2021.
Have you ever travelled abroad? — Yes, I went to Peru two years ago.
Have you ever lost a document? — Yes, I lost my passport last summer.
Have you met the new manager? — Yes, I met her on Monday.
Have you ever moved house? — Yes, I moved to Envigado last year.

A2-4-1.name: Five-step process
A2-4-1.prompt: Describe cada proceso en exactamente cinco pasos, con un adverbio de secuencia distinto en cada paso.
answers: First, boil the water. Then put the coffee in the filter. Next, pour the water slowly. After that, wait two minutes. Finally, serve the coffee.
First, compress the file. Then open a cloud service. Next, upload the file. After that, copy the link. Finally, send the link by email.
First, I leave home at six. Then I walk to the station. Next, I take the metro. After that, I change to a bus. Finally, I walk to school.
First, I make a study plan. Then I review my notes. Next, I do practice exercises. After that, I check my answers. Finally, I sleep well the night before.
First, choose a bank. Then make an appointment. Next, take your ID. After that, fill in the forms. Finally, sign the contract.

A2-5-0.name: Plan or offer
A2-5-0.prompt: Para cada situación, di una oración con «going to» (plan o evidencia) y otra con «will» (decisión del momento).
items: a heavy bag on the floor
answers: That bag is going to fall. / I’ll carry it for you.
I’m going to visit my cousins in Spain. / I think I’ll go to the beach too.
Nobody is going to answer it. / I’ll get it.
Look at those clouds. It’s going to rain this afternoon. / I’ll take an umbrella.
She’s going to get lost. / I’ll show her the way.

A2-5-1.name: Grade the pressure
A2-5-1.prompt: Di la misma idea de tres formas: como obligación, como consejo y como algo que no es obligatorio.
answers: You have to arrive on time. / You should arrive on time. / You don’t have to arrive on time.
You have to bring your own laptop. / You should bring your own laptop. / You don’t have to bring your own laptop.
You have to register in advance. / You should register in advance. / You don’t have to register in advance.
You have to wear formal clothes. / You should wear formal clothes. / You don’t have to wear formal clothes.
You have to pay a deposit. / You should pay a deposit. / You don’t have to pay a deposit.

A2-6-0.name: Swap in the pronoun
A2-6-0.prompt: Di cada oración con el sustantivo completo y repítela cambiando el objeto por un pronombre.
answers: Turn off the lights. → Turn them off.
Hand in the report. → Hand it in.
Look after the children. → Look after them.
Pick up the parcel. → Pick it up.
Put away the chairs. → Put them away.

A2-6-1.name: Three levels of ask
A2-6-1.prompt: Haz cada petición tres veces: Can you… / Could you… / Would you mind…
answers: Can you repeat the last point? / Could you repeat the last point? / Would you mind repeating the last point?
Can you send the figures again? / Could you send the figures again? / Would you mind sending the figures again?
Can you move the meeting to four? / Could you move the meeting to four? / Would you mind moving the meeting to four?
Can you check my email? / Could you check my email? / Would you mind checking my email?
Can you cover for me on Friday? / Could you cover for me on Friday? / Would you mind covering for me on Friday?

A2-7-0.name: Two ways to say why
A2-7-0.prompt: Explica el propósito de cada cosa dos veces: una con «to + verbo» y otra con «for + -ing».
answers: A password manager is used to store passwords. / It’s for storing passwords.
A shared calendar is used to organise meetings. / It’s for organising meetings.
A group chat is used to share news quickly. / It’s for sharing news quickly.
A checklist is used to remember every task. / It’s for remembering every task.
A backup drive is used to keep copies of files. / It’s for keeping copies of files.

A2-7-1.name: Instruction, then suggestion
A2-7-1.prompt: Da cada paso dos veces: como imperativo directo y suavizado como sugerencia.
answers: Restart the router. / Try restarting the router.
Check the cable. / It’s a good idea to check the cable.
Update the app. / Make sure you update the app.
Change the password. / I’d recommend changing the password.
Contact support. / The best thing to do is to contact support.

A2-8-0.name: Name the moment
A2-8-0.prompt: Completa cada frase con una cláusula de tiempo y luego dila otra vez sin «when».
answers: the day when I got my first job → the day I got my first job
the year when I finished school → the year I finished school
the moment when I saw the sea for the first time → the moment I saw the sea for the first time
the summer when we travelled to Cartagena → the summer we travelled to Cartagena
the week when everything went wrong → the week everything went wrong

A2-8-1.name: Future in two clauses
A2-8-1.prompt: Une cada par en una sola oración con una conjunción de tiempo, sin poner «will» en la cláusula de tiempo.
items: I finish work / I call you
the file uploads / you can close the tab
you get home / send me a message
answers: When I finish work, I’ll call you.
We’ll start as soon as she arrives.
After the file uploads, you can close the tab.
When you get home, send me a message.
We’ll leave when the rain stops.

A2-9-0.name: Three frames, one topic
A2-9-0.prompt: Toma cada tema y di tres oraciones en orden: used to, now, going to. Mantén el mismo sujeto en las tres.
answers: I used to take the bus. Now I ride a bike. Next year I’m going to buy an electric scooter.
I used to watch TV every night. Now I play tennis. Next year I’m going to learn to dance salsa.
My city used to be small and quiet. Now it’s very busy. Next year it’s going to have a new metro line.
We used to print everything at work. Now we use apps for everything. Next year we’re going to work fully online.
I used to eat a lot of meat. Now I eat more vegetables. Next year I’m going to try a vegetarian diet.

A2-9-1.name: Consequence chain
A2-9-1.prompt: Un estudiante da una condición y el siguiente convierte la consecuencia en la nueva condición. Sigan la cadena seis veces sin usar «will» después de «if».
items: If you don’t back up the file…
answers: If I miss the bus, I’ll be late for work.
If it rains on Saturday, we’ll stay at home and watch a film.
If the client says no, we’ll change the offer.
If you don’t back up the file, you’ll lose all your work.
If we finish early, we’ll go for a coffee.

A2-10-0.name: Match the auxiliary
A2-10-0.prompt: Responde a cada afirmación con la respuesta corta correcta y luego agrega una razón con «because».
answers: So do I, because you can do whatever you want.
Neither have I, because I don’t like raw fish.
Neither did I, because my neighbours were very noisy.
So am I, because I want to drive to work.
Neither can I, because they give me nightmares.

A2-10-1.name: Three ways to say why
A2-10-1.prompt: Toma cada par de causa y resultado y exprésalo tres veces: con because, con because of y con so.
answers: The match was cancelled because it rained heavily. / The match was cancelled because of the heavy rain. / It rained heavily, so the match was cancelled.
The call dropped because there was no signal. / The call dropped because of the bad signal. / There was no signal, so the call dropped.
We booked because the tickets were cheap. / We booked because of the cheap tickets. / The tickets were cheap, so we booked.
I missed the meeting because the train was late. / I missed the meeting because of the late train. / The train was late, so I missed the meeting.
The restaurant closed because it had bad reviews. / The restaurant closed because of the bad reviews. / It had bad reviews, so the restaurant closed.

A2-11-0.name: Flip the sentence
A2-11-0.prompt: Pasa cada oración activa a pasiva con «by» + agente. Luego dila sin el agente y decide cuál versión es mejor.
items: A local artist painted the mural.
Someone stole my bike last night.
The team finished the prototype in March.
answers: The mural was painted by a local artist.
My bike was stolen last night.
The prototype was finished in March.
The roof was repaired by my uncle.
All the flights were cancelled.

A2-11-1.name: How it’s done
A2-11-1.prompt: Describe cada proceso en tres oraciones en presente pasivo, en orden y sin decir quién lo hace.
answers: The coffee cherries are picked. Then the beans are dried and roasted. Finally, the coffee is brewed and served.
The package is collected. Then it is taken to a warehouse. Finally, it is delivered to your door.
The application form is filled in. Then the documents are checked. Finally, the passport is printed and sent to you.
The ingredients are mixed. Then the dough is left to rise. Finally, the bread is baked in the oven.
The dialogue is transcribed. Then it is translated. Finally, the subtitles are added to the film.

A2-12-0.name: Interrupted
A2-12-0.prompt: Completa cada fondo con una interrupción en pasado simple; luego cambia el orden y agrega la coma.
items: She was writing the report when…
They were boarding the plane when…
I was about to leave when…
answers: I was walking home when it started to rain. → When it started to rain, I was walking home.
She was writing the report when the computer crashed. → When the computer crashed, she was writing the report.
We were having dinner when the lights went out. → When the lights went out, we were having dinner.
They were boarding the plane when the fire alarm rang. → When the fire alarm rang, they were boarding the plane.
I was about to leave when my boss called. → When my boss called, I was about to leave.

A2-12-1.name: How long?
A2-12-1.prompt: Responde cada pregunta dos veces: una con «for» y otra con «since», usando el presente perfecto continuo cuando el verbo lo permita.
answers: I’ve been working here for three years. / I’ve been working here since 2023.
I’ve been living in Bogotá for ten years. / I’ve been living in Bogotá since 2016.
I’ve been studying English for six months. / I’ve been studying English since April.
I’ve had my phone for two years. / I’ve had it since 2024.
I’ve known my best friend for fifteen years. / I’ve known her since primary school.
